svg.desc: Alstom Cogelex Headquarter LOCATION New Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Alstom Transport COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2019 30 mil EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2019, Alstom Transport's headquarters in Cairo's 5th Settlement spans two floors of 1,500 m2 each, with a featured 200 m2 office in Cairo Festival City, designed to enhance project communication and administration. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
